candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to unlockTime so Put sets unlockTime to _unlockTime even if it's less than current block.timestamp (removes max with block.timestamp).
Replace require check with a stricter check that disallows zero-value deposits (requires msg.value > 0).
Replace addition to acc.balance with assignment (overwrite balance with msg.value instead of incrementing).
Insert a statement that doubles the deposited value before updating acc.balance (multiplies msg.value by 2 in effect).
Replace log call to record a different tag so external observers see different event-like history (Data changed from "Put" to "Deposit").
Change the withdrawal condition to allow Collect when block.timestamp >= unlockTime (was >), permitting collection exactly at unlock time.
Remove the MinSum check so collection can proceed regardless of minimum balance value.
Change balance decrement to set balance to zero regardless of _am, causing Collect to withdraw requested amount but zero out account.
Move the log call to before the external call, so LogFile.AddMessage executes prior to sending funds.

Make the external call use transfer-style revert by requiring success instead of reverting on failure block explicitly (replace conditional with require), preserving behavior but changing revert point (affects gas/forwarding patterns).
